text.text: The new MDS 9706 Director joins the industry’s most reliable storage Director MDS 9700 family with high performance, high available fully redundant components and fault-tolerant architecture. The MDS 9706 is design to seamlessly scale storage deployments for private cloud and converged infrastructures. Compact 9 rack-unit form factor to make optimal use of valuable data center floor space Up to 12-Tbps front-panel Fibre Channel switching capacity 1.5-Tbps front-panel Fibre Channel performance per slot Industry-leading port densities of up to 192 16-Gbps autosensing line-rate Fibre Channel or 10-Gbps FCoE ports per chassis True front-to-back air flow for hot-cold aisle deployments The next generation MDS innovations, a key component of the Cisco Unified Data Center, provide unmatched flexibility with its multi-protocol innovations unlike disparate solutions. The freedom of choice coupled with a single, proven operating system and management enable an evolutionary adoption and consistent SAN and LAN networking operations.

text.text: Enable convergence, scalability, and intelligence in large, virtualized data centers with the Cisco MDS 9700 48-Port 16-Gbps Fibre Channel Switching Module. With industry-leading port densities of line‑rate 16-Gbps Fibre Channel ports per director chassis, intelligent fabric services such as integrated VSANs, Inter-VSAN Routing (IVR), and PortChannels, the Cisco MDS 9700 48-Port 16-Gbps Fibre Channel Switching Module enables deployment of large, scalable, and virtualized data centers.

text.text: Multiprotocol storage networking is central to Cisco® Unified Fabric, providing a networking platform for IT departments to achieve lower total cost of ownership (TCO), enhanced resiliency, and greater agility. Cisco Unified Fabric unifies storage and data networking with the data center operating system to deliver convergence, scalability, and network intelligence. Now you can extend the benefits of FCoE beyond the access layer to the data center core with a full line-rate FCoE module for the Cisco MDS 9700 Series.

text.text: The MDS 9706 supports two Supervisor Modules and allows for redundant operation as well as hitless upgrades to software with ISSU (In Service Software Upgrade). Each Supervisor Module also has LED's that indicate System and Supervisor status, power management, logging to flash and other important indicators for a visual overview of the system.

text.text: The MDS 9706 supports up to 4 AC or DC power-supplies. Although the system needs only 2 to operate at full capacity, populating extra power-supplies allows for N+1 redundancy so a single power-supply failure does not affect system operation as well as N:N grid redundancy where half the power-supplies are from one power-grid and the rest from a second power-grid to design for power-grid failures.

text.text: Fabric Cards on the MDS 9706 support a crossbar architecture that guarantees consistent low latency through the switch independent of the traffic load. Each fabric card supports 512Gbps of backplane bandwidth per slot and each fabric is hot-swappable. This allows for up to 3Tbps per slot of front-panel FC bandwidth with all six fabric cards in place. The chassis supports a total of six fabric cards. For all 192 16G ports on the front panel, only three fabric cards are required for line-rate. Any additional fabric cards provide redundancy for no change to speed in case of a fabric card failure.

text.text: Three fan-trays are installed on the back of the MDS 9706. The fans on each fan-tray are monitored and any failures reported through LED's as well as through NX-OS. Fan-trays can be removed and replaced without turning the switch off at normal data-center temperatures - for either fan-tray replacement or adding/changing fabric cards that are behind the fan trays. Fan trays also have LED indicators for status of fabric cards behind them.
